# EmptyState

Fills a panel that has nothing to show yet, says what will appear there and why it is empty, and offers the one action that fills it; a panel is never blank.

`SongNodes.EmptyState` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.EmptyState kind="first-use" icon="…" title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.EmptyState" kind="first-use" icon="…" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (EmptyStateProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `"first-use" \| "filtered" \| "not-connected" \| "done"` | Which empty case this is; picks the default icon and wording pattern. |
| `icon` * | `string` | Lucide icon name shown muted in the circle (e.g. "list-music"). |
| `title` * | `string` | Short title in sentence case: "No sets yet". |
| `text` * | `ReactNode` | One sentence: what will appear here and why it is empty now. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | The one action that fills the panel ("Build set", "Clear filters", "Connect Tidal"); omit for "done". |
| `meta` | `ReactNode` | Optional context under the text, e.g. the active filter tags. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Smaller padding and icon for panels under 320px tall. |
